text:
jessica: T-minus 30 for the routing v3 deploy to prod. Plan = canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% over ~45m. Quick ask: who is primary for rollback and who will own smoke checks?

raj: I can be rollback primary. I'll stay on pager and watch metrics. Assign me if anything looks off. :+1:

linh: I set the DB migration flag to dry-run, nothing should write. If we need to revert, use `--migration-mode=rollback-safe`. Also preflighted the config and pushed the runtime toggle.

mike: I'll own the smoke script and run the checks. My checklist:
- liveness probe 
- p50/p95 latency against baseline (run /smoke/latency)
- error rate (500/unknown)
- KV cache hit sanity
- sample inference quality on 5 prompts

mike: smoke command in case you need to run locally:```bash
./scripts/smoke-checks.sh --target prod --routes routing-v3 --samples 5
```

sre-oncall: I'll hook up the dashboards and alerting. I'll watch service errors and the svc:router p95. If spike > 2x baseline or error rate >0.5% we pause and rollback.

raj: tagging @mike and @sre-oncall for canary monitoring. If Mike gives green at 1% we move to 10% after 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary job started: routing-v3 @ 1% (job id: cb-332100-1). Links: https://deploys.internal/cb-332100-1

mike: Running smoke now... quick hits: liveness ok, p50 +5%, p95 +12%, errors 0.12%, cache hit ratio unchanged. Doing quality samples.

mike: quality samples look good (no hallucinations). :white_check_mark: I give green for 1% -> proceed to 10%.

raj: Roger. Rolling to 10% in 2m. I'm watching rollback path ready.

deploy-bot: Canary update: routing-v3 @ 10% (job id: cb-332100-2).

mike: Re-running smoke for 10%... liveness ok, p95 +18% (within threshold), errors 0.18%. Still OK.

jessica: Thanks team — raj primary rollback, mike smoke, linh migration flag, sre-oncall monitoring. :thumbsup: I'll handle stakeholder comms. If anything degrades ping this thread and call rollback.

raj: Copy. Rollback playbook pinned: https://wiki.internal/rollbacks#routing-v3. I have the rollback command and safety window ready.

mike: moving to ramp to 100% in staged increments. I'll post updates.

sre-oncall: Alert rules set, tracing linked to this thread. Standby 2h after full roll.

jessica: Final ack: all hands set. Good luck.
